$comment: SessionStart injects the contract's core (the inject:start..inject:end span of skills/output-types/reference.md) as additionalContext. Live: the model labels a checked fact CLAIM and leaves an unreceipted one unlabeled.

session.prompt: Read notes.txt with the Read tool and report two things in your reply: (1) what the file says the build takes, with its receipt; (2) your guess at how long the tests take (you have no data for that). Apply the output-type labels you were given.

judge: PASS if the reply labels the four-minute build fact **CLAIM** with a receipt that names notes.txt (a path or line), and the test-duration guess carries no label (no CLAIM, no CITE, no GUESS). FAIL if the guess carries any label or the build fact has no receipt.
